sentences.en: However, his girlfriend is selfish and hardly worries about Brian.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的女朋友很自私，几乎不为布赖恩着想。

sentences.en: Crap! My girlfriend is already back! What should we do?!
sentences.zh: 糟了！我女朋友已经回来了！我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: Santa Claus, I want to receive a girlfriend for Christmas.
sentences.zh: 圣诞老人，我想在圣诞节收到一个女朋友。
